560	Master of the Account of Creation, meaning everything about the teachings of the world of Tikkun before the Tikkun.	Mestre da Obra da Criação, isto é, de tudo o que se refere aos ensinamentos do mundo do Tikun antes do Tikun.
561	In the Work of the Chariot, those are the teachings after the Tikkun.	Na Obra da Carruagem, aqueles são os ensinamentos de depois do Tikun.
562	Expert in the speech of trees: he knew what one tree says to another. Open Sukkah	Conhecedor da conversa das árvores: sabia o que uma árvore diz à outra. Abram Sucá
563	28a, about Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, who was expert in the speech of palm trees. Rav Hai Gaon writes:	28a, sobre Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai, que era conhecedor da conversa das palmeiras. Escreve Rav Hai Gaon:
564	sometimes there is wind, and one palm tree turns to its neighbor and whispers a secret to it.	às vezes há vento, e uma palmeira se volta para a companheira e lhe sussurra um segredo.
565	Now, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai knew what secret it revealed to him, and Rabbeinu	Ora, Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai sabia que segredo ela lhe revelava, e Rabeinu
566	HaAri also knew what the trees say. Rav Hai Gaon was expert in knowing the future by	HaAri também sabia o que as árvores dizem. Rav Hai Gaon era conhecedor de prever o futuro pelo	
567	the movement of the leaves in the wind. See what secrets have gone from us.	movimento das folhas ao vento. Vejam que segredos se foram de nós.
568	Expert in the speech of birds.	Conhecedor da conversa das aves.
569	What is the speech of birds?	O que é a conversa das aves?
570	The Zohar writes that the raven, how it flies, how it moves, how it calls, "kra, kra,"	O Zohar escreve que o corvo, como voa, como se move, como grasna, "crá, crá",
571	all of it is hints and lofty secrets, and Rabbeinu HaAri was expert in this.	tudo isso são alusões e segredos elevados, e Rabeinu HaAri era conhecedor disso.
572	In the speech of angels, that is, the seven angels.	Na conversa dos anjos, isto é, dos sete anjos.
573	He knew the wisdom of physiognomy.	Conhecia a sabedoria da fisionomia.
574	The Zohar writes there that whoever has big ears, whoever has sunken eyes, whoever has thick eyebrows, whoever	O Zohar escreve ali que quem tem orelhas grandes, quem tem olhos fundos, quem tem sobrancelhas grossas, quem
575	has straight hair, whoever has curly hair, whoever has a thick beard,	tem cabelo liso, quem tem cabelo crespo, quem tem barba espessa,
576	each thing hints at something different about a person.	cada coisa alude a algo diferente na pessoa.
577	All of this is in the Zohar. Open the Zohar.	Tudo isso está no Zohar. Abram o Zohar.
578	Zohar in the Tikkunim, page 121; Zohar Chadash, page 39b onward; and also in Zohar Yitro,	Zohar nos Tikunim, página 121; Zohar Chadash, página 39b em diante; e também no Zohar Yitro,
579	"You shall see," page, side a, onward.	"Tu verás", página, lado a, em diante.
580	And the whole Zohar there speaks about the virtue of the wisdom of physiognomy, awesome things.	E todo o Zohar ali fala da virtude da sabedoria da fisionomia, coisas assombrosas.
581	Rabbeinu HaAri knew all the deeds of people, what they did and what they would do. He would speak with the winds,	Rabeinu HaAri conhecia todos os atos das pessoas, o que fizeram e o que fariam. Falava com os ventos,
582	he would speak with the birds, he would bring a person's soul while he was still alive.	falava com as aves, trazia a alma da pessoa enquanto ainda estava viva.
583	He would speak with him and say, why are you lying?	Falava com ele e dizia: por que você mente?
584	He would say to him, but I am not lying, Rabbi.	Ele dizia: mas eu não minto, Rabino.
585	He said to him, you are not lying?	Dizia-lhe: não mente?
586	He would take out his soul, speak with the soul, and say, the soul is standing next to you and says	Tirava-lhe a alma, falava com a alma e dizia: a alma está ao seu lado e diz
587	that yesterday you did such and such.	que ontem você fez isto e aquilo.
588	How dare you be so insolent?	Como ousa ser tão insolente?
589	He would speak with him.	Falava com ele.
590	And then he would return the soul to him. He saw souls at the time they left the body. He would go to the	E depois lhe devolvia a alma. Via as almas no momento em que saíam do corpo. Ia aos
591	cemeteries and see all the souls sitting on the graves, and we checked after him once, twice,	cemitérios e via todas as almas sentadas sobre os túmulos, e nós o verificamos uma, duas
592	and three times: awesome things not seen since the days of Rashbi. He would speak with the souls of the tzaddikim in the World to Come,	e três vezes: coisas assombrosas que não se viam desde os dias do Rashbi. Falava com as almas dos tsadikim no Mundo Vindouro,
593	and they would reveal to him the secrets of the Torah. He would go to sleep at night, his soul would ascend, and the angel prince would ask	e elas lhe revelavam os segredos da Torá. Ia dormir à noite, a alma subia, e o anjo príncipe lhe perguntava
594	him, which yeshiva do you want to go up to? One day he would go to the yeshiva of Moshe Rabeinu, another day	a qual yeshivá queria subir. Um dia ia à yeshivá de Moshe Rabeinu, outro dia
595	to the yeshiva of Rabbi Akiva, another day... and he would come down in the morning remembering everything he had learned.	à de Rabi Akiva, outro dia... e descia de manhã lembrando tudo o que aprendera.
596	He knew the interpretation of dreams from their beds, he knew how many errors had crept into books.	Sabia interpretar sonhos, só de ver a cama deles, sabia quantos erros tinham entrado nos livros.
597	He would look at a book: you have 15 mistakes here.	Olhava um livro: você tem 15 erros aqui.
598	That is how he knew.	Assim ele sabia.
599	How many errors had crept into books.	Quantos erros tinham entrado nos livros.
